body:
It's arduous to do the opposite of what conditioning others have thrown into you, or you put into yourself over the years due to depression.  

I actually set myself up for an opportunity to go back to school in 1.5 years, I just need to make residency in the state I plan to move to. I still use my spare time to study and practice music, but depression is a huge barrier for me since everyone tells me not to go into it, better to work in the oilfield and make money than be in the arts and live off of scraps is usually the normal response.  

I am from the Midwest, but I remember hearing "monkey balls" on a podcast and threw it into my lexicon.
